standaloneRustConsumer: passed with the romedb-production profile; 335 registry/git package identities match the workspace lockfile
upgradeRestore: Passed from the 0.2.13, 0.2.14, 0.2.15 and 0.2.16 packages on Node 22.0.0 and 24.19.0 (groups v0213-upgrade-restore, v0214-upgrade-restore, v0215-upgrade-restore and v0216-upgrade-restore). 0.2.13 is the floor: it changed the stored value prefix, and earlier files are refused.

engine.exceptions: the maintained engine exceptions retained, none added (romedb/docs/core-exceptions.md)

engine.change: no engine core change; RomeDB builds indexes in batches and can commit them on a private copy (Connection::set_offline_build); the same engine and patches as 0.2.16 (Turso v0.8.3, Tantivy 0.27.0)

spatial.explainReadsNoData: metered EXPLAIN reports zero rows read for every spatial form (spatial_explain_reads_no_documents_or_index_entries)

supportedScope.ownership: One owning process per database file; shared clients connect to its service
